HomePage.title: TUMACH
HomePage.welcome: Come as you are and dance at your own pace: private lessons, classes and a studio to rent.

about.title: About TUMACH
about.label: (01) About
about.text1: TUMACH is a small dance studio in Amsterdam. Take a private lesson, join a class, or rent the studio for your own practice.
about.text2: I am Nina, and this is my studio. I teach private lessons and classes, at the pace that suits you.
about.text3: Beginners and experienced dancers are both welcome. We start where you are.

StudioGuide.title: How to use the studio app
StudioGuide.intro: Three short steps. You do them once on your phone.
StudioGuide.loginEmail: Type your email and tap "Send me a code".
StudioGuide.loginCode: Look in your email. Type the code of 6 numbers and tap "Log in".
StudioGuide.installTitle: Put the app on your home screen
StudioGuide.installIphone: iPhone (Safari): tap the Share button (the square with an arrow up), then "Add to Home Screen", then "Add".
StudioGuide.installAndroid: Android (Chrome): tap the menu (three dots at the top right), then "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
StudioGuide.installOpen: From now on, open the app with the TUMACH icon on your home screen.
StudioGuide.pushTurnOn: Open the app from your home screen and tap "Turn on notifications".
StudioGuide.pushAllow: Your phone asks if the app may send notifications. Tap "Allow".
StudioGuide.pushTest: Tap "Send a test". A notification comes on your phone.
StudioGuide.link: How does the app work? Read the guide

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.intro: What this site keeps of you, why, who sees it and for how long.
Privacy.bookingWhat: When you book, the site keeps your name, email address, phone number and the language of the site.
Privacy.bookingWhy: Nina uses them to answer your request, to send you the emails about your booking (the answer, the reminder and the payment link) and to reach you about the lesson.
Privacy.bookingWho: Only Nina sees them. The emails go through our email service, Mailgun.
Privacy.keep: {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} after your lesson, the site removes your name, email address and phone number by itself.
Privacy.backup: Each night the site makes a backup of its data for the case of a fault. A backup keeps a copy of your data for {nights, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}}, then the site removes it.
Privacy.contactWhat: The site keeps no copy of your message: it sends one email to Nina.
Privacy.contactSpam: Against spam, the site keeps the internet address of your device in its memory for at most one hour.
Privacy.cookies: You need no account. The site uses no tracking and no advertising cookies.
Privacy.ask: To get a copy of your data or to have it removed, write to Nina with the contact form.
